Number.title: A number.
Number.description: A hexadecimal (0x prefix) or decimal number.

items.title: A polynomial.
items.description: A polynomial over coefficients. The coefficients are either numbers or polynomials. Zeros are implicit and do not need to be specified.

Element.title: A field element.
Element.description: A field element is either a raw number, Vector of Numbers, or a polynomial.

Weierstrass.title: The short-Weierstrass curve model.
Weierstrass.description: The short-Weierstrass curve model, requires the a and b coefficients. See https://www.hyperelliptic.org/EFD/g1p/auto-shortw.html.

Edwards.title: The Edwards curve model.
Edwards.description: The Edwards curve model, requires the c and d coefficients. See https://www.hyperelliptic.org/EFD/g1p/auto-edwards.html.

TwistedEdwards.title: The twisted-Edwards curve model.
TwistedEdwards.description: The twisted-Edwards curve model, requires the a and d coefficients. See https://www.hyperelliptic.org/EFD/g1p/auto-twisted.html.

Montgomery.title: The Montgomery curve model.
Montgomery.description: The Montgomery curve model, requires the a and b coefficients. See https://www.hyperelliptic.org/EFD/g1p/auto-montgom.html.

PrimeField.title: A prime field.
PrimeField.description: A prime field of large characteristic. The prime `p` should have `bits` bits.

BinaryField.title: A binary extension field.
BinaryField.description: A binary extension field (characteristic 2). The `poly` polynomial should have `degree` degree (which should be equal to `bits`). It can either specify a polynomial basis (`basis` = `poly`) or normal basis (`basis` = `normal`).

ExtenstionField.title: A general extension field.
ExtenstionField.description: A general extension field (of characteristic not equal to 2). The `poly` polynomial should have `degree` degree. The `bits` should specify in how many bits the field representation fits (generally `degree` * number of bits of the base field). The `base` is the characteristic of the field.

TowerField.title: A field tower.
TowerField.description: A field tower is a nested sequence of field extensions. Each level extends its base field using an irreducible polynomial whose highest power is equal to the extension degree. The root base of the tower is always a PrimeField. Elements of a field tower are represented as (nested) polynomials whose power values range from 0 to degree-1.

Point.title: An affine point.
Point.description: An affine point with `x` and `y` coordinates.

trace_of_frobenius.title: The trace of Frobenius.
trace_of_frobenius.description: The trace of Frobenius of the curve.

embedding_degree.title: The embedding degree.
embedding_degree.description: The embedding degree of the curve with respect to its order.

anomalous.title: Anomalousness.
anomalous.description: Whether the curve is anomalous or not.

supersingular.title: Supersingularity.
supersingular.description: Whether the curve is supersingular or not.

cm_disc.title: The fundamental discriminant.
cm_disc.description: The fundamental discriminant of the curve's CM order.

conductor.title: The conductor.
conductor.description: The conductor of the curve's CM order.

Characteristics.title: Curve characteristics.
Characteristics.description: Some miscellaneous characteristics of the curve.

Curve.title: An elliptic curve.
Curve.description: An elliptic curve in one of the four allowed forms, specified over some field.
